notes: Root cause of the long-running 'Foundry 14.367 identifier bug': FEHA_WEAPON_CATALOG's norm/slug helpers had double-escaped regexes. norm stripped capitals and digits before lowercasing (Achilles -> 'chilles', MA70/HMG -> blank) and slug never replaced spaces, so the catalog wrote invalid identifiers like 'osprey prototype' and Foundry correctly rejected the update.
Fixed norm, slug, diceParts and the damage-field comparison in FEHA_WEAPON_CATALOG (same four double-escaped regex literals).
The nested identifier checks also treated unset optional fields (undefined) as invalid, quarantining 143 healthy items; they now skip unset values.
World hygiene removes the cleanup-safe legacy attack stubs (empty default attacks beside the real DEX attack).
All 135 weapons were backed up to compendium world.feha-weapon-backup-2026-09-30 before this build loaded.
No weapon damage, balance, stock, DEX rules or reload cadence changed; previously-skipped weapons receive the existing canonical catalog and economy values.
